intended_use: Sproto Fighter Ranch stage fight theme, all Sproto Ranch levels, Story and Level Select, seamless loop
notes: 192 bars of 4/4 at 125 BPM is 368.64 s (17,694,720 samples at 48 kHz). The container is 368.664 s because of MP3 priming (1105 samples, start time 0.023021 s) and one trailing frame. Chrome decodeAudioData and ffmpeg drop that priming and land on exactly 17,694,720 samples, so loopStart is 0 and loopEnd is 368.64 s. The wrap step is about 0.0008, under a normal sample step, so no seam ramp is applied. No loudness trim: the true peak is -1.4 dBTP, under 0 dBFS at unity gain. Decoded stereo float PCM is 141,557,760 bytes. With Trenches (138,240,000), City (141,557,760) and Marina (141,557,760) the four buffers would be 562,913,280 bytes, so only the selected stage's long bed stays decoded. A failed decode still falls back to the synthesised fight loop. Replaces ranch_country_loop_v2.mp3.
